mapper.select: select id, name,birthday,talent,avatarurl,sex from 0721acgn.tb_acgnuser where id = #{id}
select id, name, birthday, talent, avatarurl, sex from 0721acgn.tb_acgnuser order by rand() limit 1

select name, avatarurl, sex, birthday, talent from 0721acgn.tb_acgnuser where trim(birthday) != '' and ( ( month( coalesce( str_to_date(trim(birthday), '%Y-%m-%d'), str_to_date(trim(birthday), '%Y/%m/%d'), str_to_date(trim(birthday), '%m-%d'), str_to_date(trim(birthday), '%m/%d'), str_to_date(trim(birthday), '%c-%e'), str_to_date( replace(replace(replace(trim(birthday), '月', '-'), '日', ''), '.', '-'), '%c-%e' ) ) ) = #{month} and day( coalesce( str_to_date(trim(birthday), '%Y-%m-%d'), str_to_date(trim(birthday), '%Y/%m/%d'), str_to_date(trim(birthday), '%m-%d'), str_to_date(trim(birthday), '%m/%d'), str_to_date(trim(birthday), '%c-%e'), str_to_date( replace(replace(replace(trim(birthday), '月', '-'), '日', ''), '.', '-'), '%c-%e' ) ) ) = #{day} ) or trim(birthday) in ( concat(lpad(#{month}, 2, '0'), '-', lpad(#{day}, 2, '0')), concat(#{month}, '-', #{day}), concat(lpad(#{month}, 2, '0'), '-', #{day}), concat(#{month}, '-', lpad(#{day}, 2, '0')) ) or right(trim(birthday), 5) in ( concat(lpad(#{month}, 2, '0'), '-', lpad(#{day}, 2, '0')), concat(#{month}, '-', #{day}), concat(lpad(#{month}, 2, '0'), '-', #{day}), concat(#{month}, '-', lpad(#{day}, 2, '0')) ) ) limit 1
